figurative_meaning_en: Vague expression indicating unwillingness or disagreement
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাকে যেতে বললাম, কিন্তু সে গাঁইগুঁই করতে লাগল।
প্রস্তাব শুনে সে গাঁইগুঁই করে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: I told him to go, but he started hemming and hawing.
Upon hearing the proposal, he began to mumble in reluctance.
note: This idiom is onomatopoeic, mimicking sounds of hesitation common in spoken Bengali.
